referenceFunction.generalComment: Only a small number of run-of-river power plants are used for the calculation. They were built between 1945 and 1980. The lifetime assumed is 80 years for the dams and 40 for the other materials. The data set describes a mix and is therefore not representative for individual plants. This dataset is recalculated based on Frischknecht et al. (1996) and Bauer (2007), complemented with data from Axpo (2008).; UUID: d64314f2-d239-3a64-bbfa-33e16a5706d3
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset includes the most important materials used for the construction of an average run-of-river hydropower plant: cement, gravel, water, steel, copper and explosives. Furthermore, transports, the energy used, particle emissions and disposal/recycling of the materials are included.
referenceFunction.name: Run-of-river hydropower plant

technology.text: Mix of run-of-river hydropower plants built between 1945 and 1980, representative for Europe. Capacity: 8.6MW.
